25891d6163d1.english: Resolved at source: the paper's table gives GluN2B 113, GluN2C 7.0 and GluN2D 2.7 micromolar; the registry rows for GluN2B and GluN2C hold micromolar numbers entered as nanomolar (inference for the cause, data for the identity of the numbers).

34131fc4458c.english: No maximum per subunit is reported; the GluN2B value is a fitted IC50 with complete inhibition assumed. A registry value under a target can fail by unit, not only by subunit.

44f1841a4f7f.english: Re-record the sIPSC under glutamate block with a fixed threshold and per-animal summary first, then E_GABA by gramicidin perforated patch in littermates, then the age series; the lever, against a GABA-A potentiator and a non-GABAergic suppression matched to the same measured effect, only after these.

8469c8e9d812.english: None; kept so the filing is not mistaken for evidence: the registry row is not evidence of GluN2B potency in nanomolar.

a0da570946e1.old_english: Per-animal parvalbumin cell counts by immunostaining in neuron-targeted Wwox deletion against Cre-only controls, at least 3 animals per arm (reopening condition (c) of NP3A1), read together with a maturation and identity marker panel in the same animals, and, where the data holders allow, intrinsic-property and inhibitory-input recordings from labelled parvalbumin cells and a circuit-level read. Alternatives that also reopen it: a deposited library or animal index for GSE158684, or an independent neuron-targeted deletion dataset with at least 3 animals per arm and a parvalbumin-enriched capture. The result is read as six separate rows (number, identity and maturation, marker expression, intrinsic properties, synaptic input, circuit function); a change in one is not carried to another. In every animal used (P14 to P17, matching the phenotype window), on the same sections: a parvalbumin marker, the Rosa26 tdTomato reporter and a Wwox read-out, reporting per animal the fraction of parvalbumin cells reporter-positive, the fraction Wwox-negative and their concordance, beside cell number, identity and marker expression; transcript, protein, activity, cell number and circuit function stay separate results.
